citations.assessment: The Bavli attests the full name. Heilprin's corresponding notice records an alternative name in quotation witnesses. Retain his explicit reservation.

The available Menachot text gives Akiva bar Rabbi Ḥanina. The parallel in Shabbat gives Yaakov bar Rabbi Ḥanina, supporting the glossator's proposed form while leaving the transmitted citation and correction explicitly separate.
